description: Undo an applied (auto-applied or approved) CRM proposal: restores the value it replaced, writes an audit entry and lists the dependent records the change affected (for example a forecast). Requires `approve` scope; an agent key is refused.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

name: anyforge_revert_crm_proposal
title: Revert crm proposal
